_source: Fowl Play design doc pp. 6-9 (the arsenal). Interval = seconds between shots; spread = degrees; range = metres before accuracy falls off. Prices the OCR lost are marked guessed.

guns.name: The Zapper
guns.note: The classic; never sold, never lost

guns.name: Twin Zappers
guns.note: Two at once; each hand aims slightly differently

guns.name: Long Zapper
guns.note: One-shots geese; big kick

guns.name: Pump Shotgun
guns.note: Spread; the pigeon flock's nightmare

guns.name: Double Barrel
guns.note: Both barrels at once (right mouse) for a wide blast

guns.name: Auto Shotgun
guns.note: Expensive and greedy

guns.name: Pocket SMG
guns.note: Spray at a flock; poor at range

guns.name: Tommy
guns.note: The drum is a toy biscuit tin

guns.name: Carbine
guns.note: Accurate at range

guns.name: Lever Rifle
guns.note: Satisfying click; good on golden ducks

guns.name: Battle Rifle
guns.note: The all-rounder

guns.name: Hunting Sniper
guns.note: A scope; one-shots everything but the UFO

guns.name: Light Machine Gun
guns.note: Pins you in place while firing (no stepping); price guessed (the OCR lost it)

guns.name: Belt-fed Heavy
guns.note: Needs its bipod on the rail; can't turn more than 90 degrees

guns.name: Flare Pistol
guns.note: A flare lights birds (and night rounds) for everyone; buy flares

guns.name: Crab Cannon
guns.note: A live crab clamps a bird and drags it down (a kill after 1 s); misses walk back

guns.name: Gatling Gun
guns.note: Spins up for 1 s, then a firehose; turning it is slow

guns.name: Ray Gun
guns.note: A slow green beam; anything in it turns into a roast chicken

guns.name: Net Launcher
guns.note: A weighted net catches up to three birds; they fall together

guns.name: Bread Gun
guns.note: Birds that eat it fly slowly toward your stall for 3 s

guns.name: Boomerang Blaster
guns.note: Arcs out and back, hitting everything both ways; catch it or lose it

guns.name: Bubble Cannon
guns.note: Bubbles float a bird up for 4 s; pop it for the kill (anyone can)

guns.name: Magnet Gun
guns.note: Pulls metal: armored ducks are yanked to the rail, the UFO too

guns.name: Firework Launcher
guns.note: A rocket that bursts into a sky-wide spray: a few random kills and a show

guns.name: Plunger Rifle
guns.note: The first plunger makes a bird fly slow and erratic; a second kills

guns.name: Leaf Blower
guns.note: Blows birds back toward the porch (they stay longer) and hats off

guns.name: Banana Bazooka
guns.note: A bunch that splits into five bananas in the air; each kills a small bird

guns.name: The Honker
guns.note: A goose call: every goose and swan turns toward you for 3 s

guns.name: Lightning Rod
guns.note: A toy tesla gun; the bolt chains between birds up to five times

guns.name: The Mega Zapper
guns.note: One huge shot per 3 s kills everything in a wide cone; the flash blinds everyone
